name: Crying
description: Generic actively-upset state. Apply with [state <char> -> crying]. Layers tears and a shaky, raw affect onto the character; overlays append to existing anatomy prose.

properties.affect_summary: Crying — emotionally overwhelmed, voice unsteady, defenses down. Whatever she says comes out cracked and unguarded.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Wipes at her eyes with the back of a hand or a sleeve, hitches on her breath, voice catching and breaking, looks away when it gets to be too much.

body_overlays.head: Her eyes are red-rimmed and glassy with tears, lashes wet and clumped, cheeks streaked and flushed; her nose has gone pink and she keeps sniffling.
body_overlays.chest: Her breath comes in uneven, hitching pulls, chest jerking with each suppressed sob.
